audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level-chart rows disagree with the whys printed beside them. whys[0] says 'Level 1 Ziggs out-ranges you' while the row says Darius; whys[2] says Apprehend 'hard-catches a dashless mage' while the row says Skill; whys[3] says 'Levels 4-5 are skill-based' while the row says Darius; whys[4] says 'Level 6 R executes the squishy Ziggs' while the row says Skill; whys[6] says 'Late it's skill-and-poke dependent' while the row says Darius.
audit.why: The packet levelChart — Ziggs/Darius/Darius/Skill/Darius/Darius/Skill — agrees with every one of those whys. The sides array is simply wrong, and it is wrong in both layers identically.
audit.corrected: All five rows flipped in both layers as one group, with ratings moved to match (level 1 to 4/10, level 3 to 7/10, levels 4-5 to 5/10, level 6 to 7.5/10, 2+ items to 5/10), and the four boilerplate whys that argued the old side rewritten.
sources: existing content whys[0], whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[6]
enemyKit Q range 850 vs ownerKit E range 535

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why carries the raw LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks', and no spike anywhere states the cooldown that actually defines every Darius all-in here.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s and is Ziggs's only escape — he has no dash. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so at rank 1 his escape returns before your pull does. Level 6 is a real Darius spike because Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage and MR does nothing about it. Late, Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 units on 120/95/70.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten without the LaTeX and around the true-damage point; spikes[1] and spikes[3] now carry the Satchel Charge and Mega Inferno Bomb numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr is invented flavour — 'maximize brush lines to drop ranged bomb targeting' and 'step sideways out of his ultimate ring' describe nothing in Ziggs's kit. Three Do/Don't bodies are copy-pasted tradeGood/tradeBad text that ignores their own titles.
audit.why: The interactions that matter and were absent: Satchel Charge knocks Ziggs away too (he takes no damage from it), which is how he escapes a landed pull; Hexplosive Minefield has a flat 16s cooldown at every rank, 900 range, and slows — it is what stops the run-down, not the poke; Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Apprehend 850 to 535 on a 6s-to-4s cooldown; and only Decimate's outer blade both heals Darius and deals full damage.
audit.corrected: tldr, report[0], report[5], dosFull[0], dosFull[1], dontsFull[0], dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] rewritten around those, each body now matching its own title.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E text, ranges and cooldowns
ownerKit Q text (blade vs handle, heal off blade)

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Plated Steelcaps while breakdown.early on the same page correctly says 'Take Mercs / MR shard — his damage is magic'. The page contradicts itself on boots.
audit.why: Every damage source in Ziggs's kit is magic damage. Armour boots do nothing here.
audit.corrected: report[8] now buys Mercury's Treads and an early Spectre's Cowl instead of Plated Steelcaps, matching breakdown.early.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is set to 'EVEN' while diffRating is 8/10, tone is the red #ff5d6c, breakdown.difficulty says 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' and report[14] says the same. One field out of five disagrees.
audit.why: At 49.56% over 1717 games with a ranged, dashless poke mage that Darius must physically reach, the four fields that say HARD are the consistent reading; the EVEN token is the outlier.
audit.corrected: diff flipped to HARD. diffRating, tone, carryRating and both difficulty strings already agreed and were left untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown drops every time he casts an ability.
audit.why: _missing rule 'autoreset-burst-tell': his damage step-up is the empowered auto, and because casting lowers its cooldown, a Ziggs who has just thrown two spells has it ready. The wind-up is the cue.
audit.corrected: Not written this pass — every phrasing that fits the remaining fields' length bands had to drop a verified cooldown to make room. Recorded here so it is not lost.

edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 on a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and you have 535 of pull — level 1 is his. Take the safe CS and wait for level 3.

edits.before: Full basic kits unlocked on both sides; spacing out displacements determines the winner. Keep the wave near your tower so Ziggs has to walk into pull range.
edits.after: Apprehend arrives and Ziggs has no dash — his only exit is Satchel Charge, so level 3 is your first real kill window. Keep the wave near your tower.

edits.before: Optimal lane control window for Darius to establish strict minion freezes. Track Satchel Charge before you commit the pull.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s at every rank — it slows you out of the run-down, so 4-5 is decided by who spends first.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, so his MR is irrelevant — at five stacks a 460-range leap kills him outright if Satchel Charge is already spent.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 units on a 70s cooldown late — he never has to be near you. Fights hinge on catching him without his W.

edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and knocks you both away. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refusing it removes half his win condition.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The handle does reduced damage and no healing — stand so he is on the blade edge, not the handle.

edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and his Satchel Charge is 20s — burn Ghost before the pull lands and he simply resets the gap.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Engage only while it is down.
edits.after: Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, and it knocks you both away. Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s slow at 900 range.

edits.before: At 5 stacks R Noxian Guillotine executes him outright — Ziggs is squishy with no escape once his W Satchel is on cooldown, so hold E for the moment his W is down and the kill is guaranteed.
edits.after: At 5 stacks Noxian Guillotine executes him — Ziggs has no dash, so once Satchel Charge is spent (20s at rank 1) he has no exit at all. Hold Apprehend for exactly that window.

edits.before: With full AP and range, Ziggs pokes you out of lane, W-Satchels away from your E, and his zone control lets him kite and chunk you before you close — skill-dependent fights hinge on whether you can force him without W up.
edits.after: With full AP Ziggs pokes you out, Satchels away from your pull, and Mega Inferno Bomb lands from 5000 units on a 70s cooldown at rank 3 — fights hinge on catching him with Satchel Charge already spent.

edits.before: Level 1 goes to Ziggs — his Q Bouncing Bomb out-ranges you and pokes you before you can walk up, so respect the poke and use minions as cover while you wait for E. Don't take free bombs trying to CS.
edits.after: Level 1 goes to Ziggs — Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 to your 535 and comes back every 6s, so respect the poke and use minions as cover while you wait for Apprehend. Don't take free bombs trying to CS.

notes: Biggest find on this page: five of seven level-chart rows contradicted their own whys, in both layers, and the packet levelChart agreed with the whys every time — so the sides array was simply wrong and is now flipped as one group. The whys themselves needed no edits. Kit flag I did NOT trust: Satchel Charge carries a 'percentHealth' derived flag, but Riot's own W text says only 'deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' with no percent-max-health component, so nothing I wrote claims percent-health damage — per the rule, description beats flag. Also left unwritten because the kits cannot settle it: whether Satchel Charge's knockback can displace Darius out of a channelling Decimate or interrupt Noxian Guillotine's leap, and whether Apprehend's pull can drag Ziggs through his own Hexplosive Minefield without triggering the mines. One verified item did not fit anywhere inside the length bands: Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown shortens each time he casts, so a Ziggs who has just used two spells has the empowered auto ready — worth a manual insert.
